title: [Bug]: WakeupDispatcher can exhaust the Redis connection pool during slow-tool offload
body:
Thanks @chenhz01 -- agreed on the budget half.

Follow-up tip `5ff7a35` on #2682 now covers what you called out:

1. Coalesce retries per `(kind, session_id)` (unchanged).
2. Exponential backoff + jit…
